description: Maintain a stream of numbers and report its earliest value that has appeared exactly once. Example 1: initialize with [2, 3, 5]; the first unique is 2, then after adding 2 it becomes 3. Example 2: after adding 3 and then 5, the remaining first unique values progress to 5 and then -1. Constraints: stream values are positive integers and operations are interleaved.
intuition: Counts identify duplicates, while a queue preserves arrival order among possible unique values.

brute_force.approach: After every insertion, recount the entire stream in order.

optimal.approach: Track frequencies and lazily discard non-unique values from the front of an arrival deque.

edge_cases: The stream may contain no unique value, in which case return -1.
A value that becomes duplicated stays out of the unique queue.
